I would like to share my personal experience when I used to work at a utensil store. I used to work as an accountant - who kept the records of everything that was purchased and sold. The shop owner trusted me a lot. One day, I told him that certain types of utensils had been lying unsold for months and that their purchase price had already dropped from what he had purchased earlier. I requested him to sell those things even at the cost price so that the next purchase lot would cost him cheaper. He listened to my words, and soon he displayed a hoarding outside his shop, which mentioned that there was a big discount offered on a certain line of products. And then, that evening, miraculously, almost half of those goods were sold. The next day, the entire lot was disposed of. He was very happy. I told him he could invest the money earned in something different and something the same. I saved him a lot of money. He not only broke even but also got enough money to purchase those same things at a lower cost. Now, he would not understand the technical term of Market Clearing, but he did it anyway. See?
